inventoryMethod: Local git ls-tree -r with core.quotePath=false for baseline and alpha.1, GitHub recursive git/trees (truncated=false) for pinned alpha.2; compare object ids with no rename inference. Path spellings are normalized to raw UTF-8 before comparison so a non-ASCII path is never counted once quoted and once unquoted. All cumulative and incremental paths enumerated once; totals reconcile with git diff --name-status --no-renames. Historical alpha.1 rows retained even when no net delta remains. Routing is provisional except rows marked owner-confirmed; it is not semantic review or implementation acceptance.
